expectations.text: Covers the core ISM hardening requirements: harden against vendor/ASD guidance (e.g., Microsoft security baselines), remove or disable unneeded services, accounts, and functionality, and maintain a documented standard operating environment
expectations.evidence: 'apply vendor hardening guidance — for Microsoft this typically means aligning to the Microsoft Security Baseline for Windows Server 2022', 'Remove or disable unnecessary features, roles, and services', 'Disable or remove unused accounts', plus a documented 'Hardening baseline/configuration standard document' in the evidence section.

expectations.text: Includes application control and patching: application control on servers where applicable, and timely patching of the OS and applications with defined timeframes
expectations.evidence: Section 3 'Application control' covers WDAC/AppLocker; Section 2 'Patch and vulnerability management' explicitly covers 'security patches within ASD-mandated timeframes based on severity... 48 hours to two weeks... routine patches monthly' plus vulnerability scanning.

expectations.text: Specifies concrete Windows Server measures (e.g., baseline/GPO configuration, disabling legacy protocols, restricting administrative tooling, local admin management) rather than generic advice
expectations.evidence: Explicitly names 'disabling legacy authentication protocols (e.g., NTLMv1, SMBv1, LM hashes)', GPO/Microsoft Security Baseline, PAWs/jump hosts, local administrator group restriction, Secure Boot/VBS/Credential Guard for Server 2022.

expectations.text: Details assessment evidence: exported configuration baselines/GPO reports, compliance-scan results against the baseline, patch status reports, application control policy exports, and change records
expectations.evidence: Evidence list explicitly includes 'GPO exports', 'Vulnerability scan reports', 'Patch compliance reports', 'Application control policy exports (WDAC/AppLocker policy XML)', and 'Change management records' — all five required categories present.

expectations.text: Structured per the skill's control-guidance format (purpose → requirement → implementation steps → audit evidence) and cites controls only in valid ISM-XXXX format without inventing numbers
expectations.evidence: Structured as 'Overview', 'What ISM System Hardening requires, by area' (7 subsections), 'Evidence to collect', 'Practical tip' — does not follow the purpose → requirement → implementation steps → audit evidence structure. No invented control numbers are cited, but the required format is not present.
